import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
n = 300
track_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(15), 20)
times = np.tile(np.arange(20), 15).astype(float)
df = pd.DataFrame({'x': rng.normal(track_ids * 0.5, 0.3, n), 'y': rng.normal(0,1,n), 'z': rng.normal(0,1,n), 'track_id': track_ids, 'time': times})

steps.name: request 3D tracks
steps.eval: const idCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'track_id'); const tCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'time'); a.requestTracks(idCol.index, tCol.index)
